foreignKeys.definition: FOREIGN KEY (subscription_id) REFERENCES subscriptions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (subscription_id) REFERENCES subscriptions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER digest_runs_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.digest_runs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER notices_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.notices FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER subscriptions_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.subscriptions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
